status: declared before confirmation access; final model hash remains to be selected
primary: For each scene, apply the existing 1-4 second, gain 0.25, 20 ms inside-span fade separately to every requested component, including absent requests. Average errors across requests within the scene, normalized by mixture mean power; then average scenes.
secondary: simultaneous attenuation of all requested components
present-target direct waveform SDR and SI-SDR
absent extraction energy and false extraction
baselines: FUSS present-only evaluator assignment, with matched present-only scores for other methods
scalar_selection: Selection-only grid 0.25 through 1.25 in 0.05 steps; chosen 0.60. Analytical selection optimum 0.5976823295097764 was diagnostic, not inference-time fitting.
candidate_selection: Retain v1 and one predeclared 12-epoch v2 pilot. Select the final candidate from selection results before confirmation. Report gain and source distortion tradeoffs next to any mean improvement. Do not choose a new model, scalar, metric, edit subset or threshold after opening confirmation.
failure_capable_interpretation: A nonpositive primary improvement over the strongest comparable non-oracle baseline does not establish the joint-refinement claim. A favorable mean alone is insufficient for broad or typical-case claims: retain win counts, median and source-reuse sensitivity, gain/absence/activity regressions and weak-source limits. No tuning or silent success after a negative confirmation result.
uncertainty: Twenty controlled scenes are a small bounded study with possible within-split source reuse. Request slots are not independent samples. No base-pretraining isolation, human listening-panel quality, stereo quality, certified speaker isolation or general field novelty claim.
long_and_natural: Supplementary operational and boundary tests use separately declared development inputs. Natural recordings have no clean-source accuracy scores. Their outcomes do not change the frozen source-reference primary metric.
